ix={a:i for i,a in enumerate(aas)}
PROT={"S. pombe":"UP000002485","S. japonicus":"UP000001744","S. octosporus":"UP000016088",
      "S. cryophilus":"UP000015464","S. osmophilus":"UP001212411"}
def load(up):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={"query":f"proteome:{up}","format":"fasta"},timeout=300)
    seqs={};h=None;b=[]
    for l in r.text.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(">"):
            if h: seqs[h]="".join(b)
            h=l[1:];b=[]
        else: b.append(l.strip())
    if h: seqs[h]="".join(b)
    return seqs
store={n:load(u) for n,u in PROT.items()}
MTL3=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O94317.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
Q=MTL3[22:85]                       # unique N-terminal region, 22% S+T
qi=np.array([ix.get(c,0) for c in Q])

# BLAST-style 3-mer neighborhood words, threshold T=13
T=13; W=3
words=defaultdict(list)
t0=time.time()
for i in range(len(Q)-W+1):
    q=qi[i:i+W]
    for a in range(20):
        s1=b62[q[0],a]
        if s1+8+8 < T: continue
        for b_ in range(20):
            s2=s1+b62[q[1],b_]
            if s2+11 < T: continue
            for c in range(20):
                if s2+b62[q[2],c] >= T:
                    words[aas[a]+aas[b_]+aas[c]].append(i)
print("neighborhood words:", len(words), "built in %.1fs"%(time.time()-t0))

def best_hsp(s):
    si=np.array([ix.get(c,0) for c in s])
    seen=set(); best=0
    for j in range(len(s)-W+1):
        w=s[j:j+W]
        if w not in words: continue
        for i in words[w]:
            d=j-i
            if (d,i//8) in seen: continue
            seen.add((d,i//8))
            # ungapped extension with X-drop = 10
            sc=int(b62[qi[i:i+W], si[j:j+W]].sum()); cur=sc; mx=sc
            a,b_=i+W, j+W
            while a<len(Q) and b_<len(s):
                cur+=b62[qi[a],si[b_]]; a+=1; b_+=1
                if cur>mx: mx=cur
                if mx-cur>10: break
            cur=mx; a,b_=i-1,j-1; run=mx
            while a>=0 and b_>=0:
                run+=b62[qi[a],si[b_]]; a-=1; b_-=1
                if run>mx: mx=run
                if mx-run>10: break
            if mx>best: best=mx
    return best

rows=[]
t0=time.time()
for sp,seqs in store.items():
    for h,s in seqs.items():
        acc=h.split("|")[1] if "|" in h else h.split()[0]
        rows.append((sp,acc," ".join(h.split()[1:])[:52], best_hsp(s)))
print("scan done in %.1fs"%(time.time()-t0))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["sp","acc","desc","hsp"])
selfs=R[R.acc=="O94317"].hsp.iloc[0]
ns=R[R.acc!="O94317"]
print("\nself HSP score (O94317):", selfs)
print("non-self (n=%d): mean %.1f sd %.1f max %d ; 99.9th pct %.0f"%(len(ns),ns.hsp.mean(),ns.hsp.std(),ns.hsp.max(),ns.hsp.quantile(0.999)))
print("\nTop non-self HSPs per species (BLAST-style ungapped, BLOSUM62, W=3, T=13, X=10):")
for sp in PROT:
    print(f"\n{sp}:"); print(ns[ns.sp==sp].nlargest(3,"hsp").to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.4))
ax.hist(ns.hsp, bins=40, color="#90a4ae", log=True)
ax.axvline(selfs, color="#c62828", lw=2)
ax.text(selfs-4, 2e3, "mtl3 self-hit = %d"%selfs, color="#c62828", rotation=90, ha="right", fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(ns.hsp.max(), color="#ef6c00", lw=1.5, ls="--")
ax.text(ns.hsp.max()+2, 3e3, "best non-self = %d\n(%s)"%(ns.hsp.max(), ns.nlargest(1,'hsp').acc.iloc[0]), color="#ef6c00", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("best ungapped HSP score vs mtl3 residues 23-85 (BLOSUM62)")
ax.set_ylabel("proteins (log scale)")
ax.set_title("BLAST-style search of mtl3's only non-repetitive region against 25,166 proteins\nfrom all five Schizosaccharomyces species: no ortholog above background", fontsize=10)
